pull_request.label: PR #87 · Fix Samantha island and preference behavior

findings.title: Closing Samantha leaves menu-bar space; Codex does not move closer
findings.observed: After Samantha was closed, the menu-bar space remained and Codex did not move toward the Dynamic Island.
findings.recommendation: Clear Samantha-owned activity, then compact the surviving plugin circles after the exit fade so Codex takes the nearest slot.
findings.verification: On the installed PR build, enable Samantha beside Codex, close Samantha by toggle and Quit, then check that her activity disappears and Codex moves into the nearest slot after the 150 ms fade.

details.Source change: IslandHub clears Samantha-owned plugin rows and releases pending controls. IslandModel compacts surviving source-group slots after the 150 ms exit fade.
details.Source verification: The repository gate passed, including the full 593-test Swift suite. Installed close/reflow acceptance remains pending.
details.Attribution: User report; attached crops show toggle states, not a measured transition.

findings.title: Samantha did not retrieve a relevant Context Ledger preference automatically
findings.observed: Samantha did not apply a relevant saved preference unless asked to consult Context Ledger.
findings.recommendation: When a preference is relevant to a choice, recall its active scope and rule automatically and apply it without asking the user to name Context Ledger.
findings.verification: After installing the PR build, ask a related, harmless task without mentioning Context Ledger. Confirm the matching saved preference is applied and that Samantha reports any ledger error clearly.

details.Source review: The existing ledger_task supports recall, preference, lookup, and capture. The PR adds proactive recall guidance; source review did not identify a missing tool capability.
details.Source verification: Ledger tests passed. User-specific preference recall has not been verified on the installed build.
details.Input privacy: No preference value or original prompt is stored in this report.

findings.title: Samantha should save durable preferences and critical decisions
findings.observed: Durable preferences and important decisions should be captured when they are stated, then reused at the right time without reminders.
findings.recommendation: Capture durable preferences in their exact scope and rule. Use the decision capture path for critical decisions, and confirm a save only after the ledger returns a receipt.
findings.verification: On the installed PR build, state one genuine non-sensitive preference, confirm the save receipt, then ask a related question later without a reminder. Check that it is recalled and used correctly.

details.Source change: The PR adds guidance for proactive preference capture and retrieval through the existing ledger_task tool.
details.Supersession rule: Updating a preference supersedes only an active user_decision with the same exact scope and rule. General captures do not auto-supersede; the current tool does not create an explicit supersedes link.
details.Source verification: Ledger tests passed. Save, later readback, and correct application remain unverified live.
details.Input privacy: The report does not include a preference value or decision content.

findings.observed: Earlier captures show square-like package marks inset inside circles. The requested design keeps the circle size and uses the package artwork edge to edge; the Comet pointer also needs room inside its circle.
findings.recommendation: Scale each package logo to fill the existing 24 pt frame and clip it to a circle. Keep the Comet glyph small enough to read clearly without adding a smaller square.
findings.verification: Installed ACU 0.2.92 at PR head 126a3ac: ACU, Comet Control, Context Ledger, and Developer Observability were visually checked in circular frames; the Comet pointer was reduced and temporary activity rows were cleared. The current uninstalled change only restores idle pill width.

findings.observed: The default island size appeared smaller after the idle width changed from 74 pt to 50 pt.
findings.recommendation: Restore the original 74 pt idle width while keeping the 24 pt height and content-driven active widths unchanged.
findings.verification: Install the updated PR head, start with no active plugin activity, and confirm the idle pill measures 74 × 24 pt. Then activate and clear a plugin row and confirm the active layout remains content-driven.

findings.title: The disconnect check fails during the full release gate
findings.observed: Installed ACU 0.2.93 full release run failed after 80 disconnects: 53 to 60 file descriptors, above the allowed maximum of 57. The test passes alone; evidence now points to a baseline taken before delayed startup work settles, but that is not yet proven by a full rerun.
findings.recommendation: Warm the service with a harmless RPC, wait for its documented 5-second island scan, then measure disconnect growth with the existing +4 descriptor limit. Do not raise the limit.
findings.verification: Keep this finding open until the full installed release gate passes with the warmed baseline. If it still fails, capture sanitized descriptor types at baseline and after the scan window.

details.Previous full run: The descriptor count grew from 55 to 63 against an allowed maximum of 59. The isolated disconnect repeat passed 2 tests.
details.Root cause: Unknown. A descriptor leak is a hypothesis, not an established cause.
details.Release status: The previous installed 0.2.92 full release gate failed while an isolated repeat passed. The updated 0.2.93 installed release gate is still pending.
details.Current installed full run: ACU 0.2.93 source checks passed (111 test processes), and client and Cursor integrations passed. live-fd failed at 53 to 60 descriptors (maximum 57). Microphone and voice stages were not reached.
details.Current isolated repeat: The updated local test warmed the installed ACU 0.2.93 service, waited 5.5 seconds, and passed both tests in 6.616 seconds with ACU_ISLAND_ACTIVITY=0.
details.Source review: SwiftNIO's local source defaults allowRemoteHalfClosure to false. SocketServer's RPC handler releases the connection count in channelInactive and handlerRemoved. The test's old half-close diagnosis is stale; no socket leak is confirmed.
details.Release test correction: Live integration steps receive ACU_ISLAND_ACTIVITY=0 per repo policy. This alone did not remove the full-run failure.
details.Baseline evidence: After the full run, the service held 60 lsof rows consistently across a 10-second idle sample. The full test began at 53 and ended at 60; delayed initialization is a plausible explanation, not yet confirmed.

findings.title: Samantha's Context Ledger task errors and retries
findings.observed: Agent telemetry reports repeated ledger_task failures. The latest Samantha activity also contains tool errors and repeated calls with different or unknown arguments.
findings.recommendation: Trace one harmless read and one preference recall through ledger_task, validate the arguments at the tool boundary, and keep retries bounded with a clear error result.
findings.verification: On the installed PR build, complete a harmless read and a preference recall. Confirm the tool arguments are valid, calls are not repeated unnecessarily, and a failed call does not claim a successful preference read.

details.Agent evidence: One Grok agent finding recorded 12 ledger_task failures through 2026-11-03.
details.Latest telemetry: The 2026-11-05 Samantha activity snapshot recorded 2 ledger_task tool errors and 7 retries with different or unknown arguments.
details.Attribution limit: The tool arguments were not captured and these events are not linked to the user's preference test. Root cause and recovery are unconfirmed.

findings.title: Voice response and audio delays
findings.observed: Developer Observability reports several slow voice and audio stages. These are leads, not confirmed user-facing latency defects.
findings.recommendation: Trace a fresh, short voice interaction end to end and optimize only the stage that remains slow in a linked run.
findings.verification: Record voice start, audio-ready, first playback, and completion timings for one fresh installed-build session. Compare them to an agreed product target before calling the result fixed.

details.Latest metrics: Speech-to-playback p95 14.8 s (p50 2.4 s, n=74); audio_ready p95 5.9 s (p50 249 ms, n=10); usage p95 4.5 s (p50 2.0 s, n=92).
details.Threshold note: The collector's 1.0 s threshold is an investigation signal, not a user-facing SLA. One aggregate speech-to-playback maximum is a 1,086.6 s outlier and needs run-level correlation.
details.Snapshot limits: Snapshot generated 2026-11-05 13:44 UTC. Source coverage is partial; no metric is linked to a current acceptance run.

findings.title: Samantha startup timing needs a clean measurement
findings.observed: Telemetry shows connection and microphone-preflight delays, alongside no-input-device failures that may be environmental.
findings.recommendation: Measure a fresh startup with a known available microphone and separate device preflight from the connection and audio-ready stages.
findings.verification: Repeat startup on the installed build with a confirmed microphone. Link stage timings and any failure to the same run before changing startup behavior.

details.Latest metrics: realtime_ws_open p95 1.9 s (p50 1.3 s, n=23); mic_preflight p95 2.9 s (p50 0 ms, n=19); audio_ready p95 5.9 s (p50 249 ms, n=10).
details.Environment signal: The collector also recorded 9 no_input_device preflight failures. This does not establish a Samantha startup regression.
details.Snapshot limits: Snapshot generated 2026-11-05 13:44 UTC. Product latency targets and current-build reproduction are not established.

findings.title: Browser-assisted Samantha turns can be slow
findings.observed: Four recorded Comet-assisted turns took 13.6–16.8 seconds. They are not linked to the latest installed build.
findings.recommendation: Repeat one representative browser task and trace Samantha and Comet timings together before selecting a fix.
findings.verification: Use one fresh browser task with correlated Samantha and Comet timing. Confirm the outcome independently and compare only against an agreed target.

details.Telemetry evidence: Four historical turns exceeded 10 seconds; the slowest was 16.8 seconds. Session identifiers are omitted.
details.Snapshot limits: Snapshot generated 2026-11-05 13:44 UTC. These events do not establish current-build performance or a root cause.

findings.title: Voice controls exceeded Dynamic Island layout bounds
findings.observed: Samantha telemetry reports voice_slot outside the island on three events and eight island_layout failures. The records are not linked to a fresh close or resize test.
findings.recommendation: Repeat voice, close, and resize checks on the installed PR build, then compare the linked layout measurements with the source result.
findings.verification: Record the installed version, run identity, and measured controls/circle bounds. Confirm every control stays inside the island through open, resize, and close.

details.Latest telemetry: Three voice_slot boundary events reported a maximum of 30.0 pt; eight island_layout failures were recorded.
details.Attribution limit: The observability snapshot does not link these records to the user's close/reflow report or a controlled resize run. Root cause is unconfirmed.
